parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is one half of the scissors, consisting of a metal blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides one cutting edge and one handle loop for gripping and applying force during cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw to open and close against the other blade handle set.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This is the second half of the scissors, also composed of a metal blade and a plastic handle loop.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the opposing cutting edge and handle loop, working together with the first blade handle set to perform cutting.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw, moving in opposition to the first blade handle set to create a shearing action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two halves together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade handle sets around it.
